description: This file contains shell functions for error checking, waiting for service states, and handling service status updates in a system management context. It defines functions like check_err, check_err_exit, wait_till_end_state, and wait_till_state, which interact with system events and logging.

methods.name: check_err
methods.description: Checks a return code; if non-zero, logs error and updates service status and error info.

methods.name: check_err_exit
methods.description: Checks a return code; if non-zero, logs error, updates service status and error info, then exits.

methods.name: wait_till_end_state
methods.description: Waits until a service is no longer in 'starting' or 'stopping' state, with a timeout.

methods.name: wait_till_state
methods.description: Waits until a service reaches a specified state, with a timeout.
